name: demo-selenium-rust-for-nhs-wales
summary: A beginner-friendly Selenium + Rust demo (using the thirtyfour crate) that drives a real browser against the real, live NHS Wales website.
description: This demo drives a real Chrome browser to https://www.nhs.wales/ using Selenium (via the thirtyfour crate) and Rust, and runs three real assertion-based checks: the home page title, the About Us page title and headline, and the search results page. It is meant as a friendly, top-to-bottom walkthrough for learning Selenium browser automation against a live production site.
